sentences.en: Sami had sleep paralysis a lot when he was a kid.
sentences.zh: 萨米小时候经常出现睡眠瘫痪。

sentences.en: There have been several cases of infantile paralysis.
sentences.zh: 曾有多起婴儿麻痹病例。

sentences.en: Sami always had sleep paralysis as a kid.
sentences.zh: 萨米小时候总是会出现睡眠瘫痪。

senses.zh: 麻痹，瘫痪,中风,无能，无气力

mnemonic: 词根记忆：para（旁边）+lys（裂开，分解）+is（表情况）→旁边分开了→麻痹
